result.label: estimate from published average factors
result.scope: Material production and entered freight are separate components. A combined figure is shown only when the material factor is an exact product match and ends at the production gate, so entered freight cannot overlap it. UK DESNZ material factors include transport to the point of sale and are UK reporting averages, so they are never combined with entered freight. Excludes use, end of life, packaging, warehousing and supplier-specific data.

factor.category: Copper cathode (99.99% Cu), global ICA member average
factor.sheet: Table 4: Results of the LCIA for Copper Concentrate and Copper Cathode According to EF 3.0 Method
factor.row: Climate Change / Results per metric tonne of Copper Cathode (99.99% Cu)
factor.system_boundary: Cradle-to-gate, from extraction at the mine to copper cathode at the refinery gate, primary and secondary routes; EF 3.0 climate change; ICA member data for reference year 2019 covering 23% of world cathode output; independently reviewed. Excludes rod drawing or other semi-fabrication and transport to the buyer.
factor.note: Industry average, not supplier-specific. For copper rod it covers the cathode only, so it understates rod production.
factor.licence: Copyright International Copper Association, All rights reserved. One published figure is cited with attribution; the document is not redistributed.

factor.label: Sea, average container ship
factor.row: Cargo ship / Container ship / Average / kg CO2e
factor.system_boundary: Direct emissions per tonne.km for this mode and average load, as published in the DESNZ Freighting goods sheet; well-to-tank fuel supply is published separately and not included.
factor.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (UK government)

legs.formula: 8 t x 1000 km x 0.01612 kg CO2e/tonne.km

estimate.combined_reason: Exact product factor ending at the production gate, plus entered freight from the supplier.
